title: RCP Advisors Celebrates 25 Years
summary: Congratulations to RCP Advisors on 25 years of investing in the U.S. lower middle market.
body_markdown:
Congratulations to RCP Advisors on 25 years of investing in the U.S. lower middle market.


In our industry, track record and incumbency are fundamental. Over the past two and a half decades, RCP Advisors has built a differentiated franchise supported by longstanding relationships, deep investment data and insights, and a proven ability to deliver attractive returns across market cycles.


Here’s to another 25 years of partnership, growth, and success.


[Watch RCP Advisors’ 25th anniversary video.](https://www.rcpadvisors.com/news/rcp-advisors-25th-anniversary-video/)
